description:
**Job Title:**
OpenShift Deployment Engineer

**Location:**
Gurgaon - Work from office (No work from home)

**Experience:**
5 – 10 Years

**Key Responsibilities**

**Bare Metal Infrastructure Management:**

Assessing and preparing physical hardware (servers) for OpenShift deployment, including network configuration, disk partitioning, and BIOS settings.

**Openshift Upgrade exp:**

**Version-to-Version Migration:**
Knowing the specific changes, deprecated features, and new requirements between different OpenShift versions (e.g., migrating from OpenShift 3 to 4, or 4.x to 4.y)

**OpenShift Installation:**

Utilizing the OpenShift installer to provision and deploy OpenShift clusters on bare metal hosts

**Cluster Configuration:**

Defining and managing OpenShift cluster components like control plane nodes, worker nodes, and network policies on bare metal infrastructure.

**Bare Metal Operator Management:**

Utilizing the "Bare Metal Operator" within OpenShift to monitor and manage the health of bare metal hosts within the cluster.

**Network Integration:**

Configuring network connectivity between OpenShift cluster nodes and external networks, including load balancers and ingress controllers.

**Troubleshooting and Support:**

Identifying and resolving issues related to OpenShift deployments on bare metal, including hardware compatibility, network connectivity, and cluster stability.

**Required skills:**

* Deep understanding of OpenShift Container Platform architecture and deployment methodologies
* Expertise in bare metal provisioning and configuration
* Proficiency with Linux system administration and networking concepts
* Knowledge of containerization technologies like Docker
* Familiarity with Kubernetes concepts and YAML configuration

Openshift deployment + Night shift and work from office. No work from home option

Shift allowances for night shift

title: Sr Network Architect (network + cloud+ security)
description:
**About Gartner IT:**
Join a world-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.
  
  
**About this role:**
Senior Network Architect is a senior technical leader responsible for the strategic vision, lifecycle planning, and architectural design of highly reliable, secure, and scalable multi-cloud and enterprise network infrastructure to support Gartner Conference and global business operations. The ideal candidate brings expert-level mastery in enterprise network design, zero-trust security frameworks, edge connectivity, and hybrid cloud ecosystems. They are passionate about setting architectural guardrails, authoring long-term technology roadmaps, and leveraging modern software-defined networking (SDN) and automation frameworks to drive transformative business outcomes.
  
  
**What you’ll do:**

* Define Strategy: Architect the global enterprise network blueprint spanning LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, multi-cloud ecosystems, and high-density event environments.
* Lead Security Architecture: Design enterprise-wide network security frameworks, integrating next-generation firewalls, SASE, zero-trust models, and micro-segmentation.
* Author Roadmaps: Establish long-term technology roadmaps, standard reference designs, and architectural guardrails Campus office, Data Center, and cloud connectivity.
* Drive Innovation: Evaluate and select emerging technologies, leading proof-of-concepts for SDN, intent-based networking, network automation, and AI frameworks.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with infrastructure team, application team, Infosec team, DevOps Team, Cloud CCOE team and End user team.
* Govern Documentation: Own the lifecycle of core reference architectures, global topology diagrams, infrastructure-as-code libraries, and standard compliance guidelines.
* Act as Highest Escalation: Serve as the ultimate technical authority for systemic, complex infrastructure or application performance anomalies.
* Mentor Teams: Provide technical governance and mentorship to senior network engineering teams, cultivating engineering excellence across the organization.

**What you’ll need:**

* Professional Experience: 12-17 years of deep technical experience in large-scale enterprise routing, switching, and complex network infrastructure design..
* Technical Governance: Ability to author and maintain global network architectural standards, high-level designs (HLD), low-level designs (LLD), and deployment blueprints.
* Core Routing & Switching: Master-level understanding of advanced routing protocols (BGP, OSPF) alongside high-density data center fabrics (spine-leaf) and modern campus network topologies.
* Enterprise Wireless: Deep technical knowledge of enterprise wireless LAN (WLAN) controllers, cloud-managed Wi-Fi architecture, RF engineering, and centralized wireless management platforms.
* Application Delivery & Load Balancing: Advanced, hands-on knowledge of F5 BIG-IP systems (LTM, DNS, APM), including deep familiarity with SSL/TLS termination, HTTP/HTTPS profiles, and iRules.
* Palo Alto Security Design: Strong experience in Palo Alto Networks infrastructure, designing secure deployments utilizing Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW) managed via Strata Cloud Manager, user-ID/app-ID policies, and cloud-delivered security services.
* SASE & Edge Architecture: Expertise to architect and scale Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) and SD-WAN frameworks to provide optimized, secure connectivity for remote users and branch offices.
* Multi-Cloud Networking: Deep knowledge of cloud-native networking constructs, designing and securing high-performance transit networks across AWS (Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, VPCs) and Microsoft Azure (Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute, vNets).

**Who You Are**

* Graduate/Postgraduate in BE/B tech, ME/MTech or MCA are preferred.
* Excellent communication and prioritization skills.
* Able to work independently or within a team proactively in a fast-paced AGILE-SCRUM environment.
* Owns success – Takes responsibility for successful delivery of the solutions.
* Ardent desire to improve upon their skills in software development, frameworks, and technologies.

Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles.
  
  
**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
  
  
**What do we offer?**
Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
  
  
In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
  
  
Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: Technical Lead ( Telecom Experience)
description:
**About Aeris Communications Inc.**
Aeris is the secure connectivity platform for Physical AI and intelligent IoT devices. It caters to connected cars, drones, autonomous mobility, robotics, utilities, energy, fleet management, logistics, medical devices, and manufacturing. Aeris serves over 7,000 enterprise customers and connects more than 115 million devices worldwide, including 41 million connected vehicles, supported by an ecosystem of 30+ mobile network operators. Enterprises rely on Aeris for the borderless connectivity, embedded security, observability, and proven scale that mission critical Physical AI programs demand.
  
  
****Location****

* Aeris Office, Gurgaon, India
* Aeris Office, Noida, India
* Hybrid 3d/wk in office

Technical leadership role in the development of a cloud-based 3GPP compliant 5G SA core network. Communicate daily with the architect and generate detailed technical designs and documentation. Take an active role in in developing delivery schedules. In addition to hands-on implementation of a number of 5G SA Network Functions, oversee and support the daily activities of other developers on the team.

* Solve Business Problems: Research solutions to solve problems and develop product
* Groom Backlog: Develop detailed requirements working peers such as Product managers, Network Engineers and Architects. Effectively transform product requirements into a solution backlog complete with definition of all required components and their interworking and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure Architectural Alignment: Work closely with team and stakeholders to review and refine system designs, ensuring the product’s security and network components are robust, well-integrated, with the right level of observability and the right unit-economics.
* Leverage Cellular Expertise: Leverage domain expertise in Cellular networks (3GPP standards, deployment, operations) to build a cutting-edge Celluar Core SaaS product.
* Create Design & Documentation Artifacts: Produce and maintain detailed technical designs, specifications, and documentation to guide both current development and future enhancements.
* Implementation: Directly develop and implement network components using technologies like Java, various databases, and network analysis tools (e.g., pcap, Wireshark, tcpdump).
* Schedule Planning: Actively contribute to setting and managing delivery schedules to meet launch
* deadlines.
* Team Oversight: Oversee and support the daily activities of other developers, including mentoring, code reviews, and troubleshooting, ensuring best practices are followed throughout the project.
* Technical Troubleshooting: Address complex technical challenges and optimize network performance.
* Adoption of New Technologies: Integrate emerging AI-powered tools and methodologies to enhance development processes.

**Mandatory Telecom Domain Experience**
Experience in some of the 3GPP Cellular Network Standards like below:
  
  

* Familiarity with 3GPP Rel 15 and later
* Cellular identifiers (ICCID, IMSI, MSISDN, IMEI)
* 2G/3G (SS7), 4G (Diameter), 5G SA (HTTP/2)
* AAA/RADIUS, SMS, SMPP
* VoLTE
* API Development & Security
* Oath2
* PKI
* mTLS, SSL
* IP networks: packet inspection, routing, IP allocation & assignment, subnets, CIDR specification, IPV6

**Must Have Skills**

* AI-powered coding assistants and effective prompt engineering, and use GenAI for technical research and documentation.
* Git source control & release compliance
* Critical thinking
* Excellent communicator: able to effectively express ideas and concepts, in both written and
* spoken forms. Can organize and lead internal discussions and present to customers

* Hands-on development experience in any programming language -- Java, Go, C++, Python, anything. We care that you write real code, not which language you use
* Database (MySQL, Oracle, Cassandra, Redis (at least one)
* Public cloud services: GCP, AWS or Azure

BS or higher degree in Computer Science or equivalent

title: Portfolio IT Executive
description:
**Job Purpose**
To ensure the smooth functioning of all hotel IT systems, hardware, software, networks, and communication systems. The IT Executive will provide day-to-day technical support to hotel colleagues, maintain system security, troubleshoot technical issues, and ensure compliance with IHG IT standards and procedures to support efficient hotel operations and a seamless guest experience.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* IT Operations and Technical Support
* Maintain and troubleshoot computers, laptops, printers, servers, network devices, Wi-Fi, and other IT equipment.
* Provide timely technical support to hotel colleagues and resolve hardware and software issues.
* Ensure the smooth functioning of hotel systems, including Property Management Systems (PMS), Point of Sale (POS), email, and other business applications.
* Monitor system performance and escalate unresolved technical issues to the IT Manager or relevant service provider.
* Network and Infrastructure Management
* Monitor hotel LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi connectivity, switches, routers, firewalls, and cabling.
* Ensure the availability and proper functioning of IT infrastructure across hotel departments.
* Maintain updated records of network devices, IT assets, and system configurations.
* Information Security and Compliance
* Follow IHG IT security policies, data protection guidelines, and access control procedures.
* Maintain antivirus and endpoint security updates and support regular system patching.
* Ensure secure access to IT rooms and equipment.
* Support PCI DSS compliance, information security audits, and closure of audit observations.
* Maintain confidentiality of guest, colleague, and business information.
* Backup and Business Continuity
* Perform and monitor regular data backups as per established procedures.
* Assist in testing backup restoration and disaster recovery arrangements.
* Report system failures, security incidents, and potential data loss risks immediately.
* IT Asset and Vendor Management
* Maintain an updated inventory of IT hardware, software, licenses, and accessories.
* Track IT equipment allocation, repairs, warranties, and replacements.
* Coordinate with external vendors and service providers for maintenance and technical support.
* Assist in preventive maintenance and ensure timely resolution of service requests.
* Documentation and Training
* Maintain IT logs, incident registers, maintenance records, and system documentation.
* Assist in implementing IT Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and brand standards.
* Guide hotel colleagues on basic troubleshooting, system usage, cybersecurity, and data security practices.
* Support IT audits, system upgrades, and new technology implementations.
* Guest and Business Support
* Ensure prompt resolution of technology-related issues affecting guest services and hotel operations.
* Provide IT support during peak operational hours and critical hotel activities.
* Coordinate with Front Office, Food & Beverage, Finance, Sales, and other departments to ensure uninterrupted business operations.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 2–4 years of experience in IT support, IT operations, or a similar role; hotel industry experience will be preferred.
* Basic knowledge of computer hardware, software troubleshooting, Windows operating systems, networking, LAN/WAN, and Wi-Fi.
* Familiarity with PMS, POS, email systems, antivirus software, backups, and IT security practices.
* Good communication, problem-solving, coordination, and documentation skills.
* Ability to work in a hospitality environment and respond to operational IT requirements as needed.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Technical troubleshooting and problem-solving
* Customer service orientation
* Attention to detail
* Teamwork and collaboration
* Time management and responsiveness
* Information security awareness
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies

IHG Values – True Hospitality
  
  

* True Attitude: Demonstrate care and a positive approach while supporting colleagues and guests.
* True Confidence: Apply technical knowledge effectively and professionally.
* True Listening: Understand user requirements and identify the root cause of issues.
* True Responsiveness: Resolve IT issues promptly to minimize disruption to hotel operations.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

title: Sr. Migration Modernization Architect, Professional Services
description:
**Description**
AWS Professional Services is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
Are you an experienced Cloud architect/developer who can assist our customers in Application modernization, Design and development of cloud native applications and/or re-engineering applications that can fully leverage the AWS Cloud? Do you like to work on a variety of game changing projects, at the forefront of application development and cloud technology adoption? This role is open for Delhi/NCR.
  
  
As an architect you would champion applications to be cloud optimized by making them well-architected ,enabling them to reap the benefits of elasticity, horizontal scalability, automation and high availability. You should have a knack of GenAI tooling to driving application modernization at scale with GenAI tools.
  
  
On the AWS platform services such as Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling, Elastic Load Balancing, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Amazon Elastic Container Services to name just a few, provide opportunities to design and build cloud ready applications.
  
  
AWS ProServe India LLP is looking for highly talented hands on technical architects to help accelerate our growing Professional Services business in India. This is an opportunity to join Amazon’s world class technical teams, working with some of the brightest engineers while also developing your skills and furthering your career within one of the most innovative and progressive technology companies.
  
  
Professional Services engage in a wide variety of projects for internal customers and partners, providing collective experience from across the AWS customer base and are obsessed about success for the internal customers. Our team collaborates across the entire AWS organization to bring access to product and service teams, to get the right solution delivered and drive feature innovation based upon customer needs.
  
  
Amazon aims to be the most customer centric company on earth. Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers critical applications for hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for hands on Mig and Mod (MM) Architects with:
  
  

* Strong Consulting, client-facing (CXO) level communication driving cloud solutioning and leading technical workshops
* Ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders into implementable solution adhering to well architected framework.
* Problem-solving and analytical thinking driving envisioning , presales and be a thought leader in the domain driving Application discovery , Risk mitigation strategies, Performance testing and validation, Migration and Post-migration optimization
* Deep expertise in large scale cloud migrations, and AWS infrastructure to drive complex cloud transformation journey from Onprem successfully modernizing them to help realize true value from cloud
* Deep expertise in VMware technologies having worked on vSphere administration, vCenter management, NSX networking, vSAN storage, HCX for migrations, VMware Cloud on AWS

* hand-on experience in designing and developing web applications, APIs, microservices, and data integrations for cloud native applications
* Knowledge of cloud-native design patterns, including microservices architecture and event-driven systems.
* Demonstrated experience building scalable and highly available applications on AWS, leveraging services such as Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, etc.
* Preferred experience in optimizing cloud-based architectures for scalability, security, and high performance.
* Experience working in Agile development environments, with a strong focus on iterative delivery and continuous improvement.
* Ability to advise on and implement AWS best practices across application development, deployment, and monitoring

**Additional Desired Skills**

* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
* Scripting (Python, PowerShell)
* CI/CD pipelines

title: MS Engineer L1 VC support
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
As a Collaboration Managed Services Engineer (L1) at NTT DATA, you will be the go-to person for ensuring our clients' Collaboration, Contact Centre and Voice systems stay up and running. Your main focus will be on providing first-line support by monitoring private and public cloud infrastructure, identifying problems early, and resolving technical incidents efficiently. You'll play a crucial role in ensuring we meet our service level agreements and deliver an excellent client experience.
  
  
Throughout the day you’ll be monitoring client infrastructure for any issues and proactively addressing them before they escalate. If incidents occur, you'll investigate and get to the root cause swiftly to restore services. Your tasks will also include executing approved maintenance activities like patching and configuration changes and providing telephonic or chat support to clients when needed.
  
  
Your role doesn't stop at issue resolution; you'll also be identifying opportunities to optimize work processes and reduce incidents. Whether it's updating existing knowledge articles, creating new ones, or finding ways to automate routine tasks, you'll actively contribute to enhancing service delivery. Your ability to adapt to changing circumstances and keep a positive outlook will be key to your success.
  
  
Effective communication is essential in this role. You'll collaborate across different cultures and social groups, plan activities comprehensively, and ensure smooth handovers during shift changes. Your commitment to placing clients at the forefront of all interactions will help create a positive client experience throughout their journey with us.
  
  
**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Basic troubleshooting skills and knowledge in network, voice, collaboration, and contact centre services.
* The ability to triage client cases effectively, ensuring that severity and impact is accurate as well as key information is documented in the case.
* Active listening techniques to confirm understanding and gather relevant information.
* Strong communication skills, able to work across different cultures and social groups.
* Flexibility and adaptability in changing circumstances.
* Positive outlook and resilience under pressure.
* Commitment to creating a positive client experience by understanding their requirements and keeping them clearly updated on progress of their case.
* Willingness to put in extra hours when necessary.
* Diploma, bachelor's degree, or relevant qualification in Information Technology or Computing (or equivalent experience).
* Relevant partner Certifications are also desirable.

**Workplace type:**
On-site Working

unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and
  
  
application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move

title: Technical Lead – Software Engineering
description:
**About ZENNER Aquamet**

At ZENNER Aquamet, we develop modern software solutions that power connected IoT ecosystems and enable secure,

data-driven decision-making. Our engineering teams build scalable web applications, APIs, and cloud-based services that

support customers across utilities, smart infrastructure, and industrial domains. We foster a collaborative environment

where engineers can learn, contribute, and grow through real-world product development.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a highly experienced, technically versatile, and hands-on Technical Lead to drive the design,

development, deployment, and maintenance of enterprise-grade software solutions.

The ideal candidate should possess comprehensive technical expertise across the entire software development lifecycle,

with the ability to independently architect, build, deploy, manage, and optimize complete software ecosystems. The role

requires a strong combination of software engineering, cloud computing, infrastructure management, system

architecture, and technical leadership capabilities.

The candidate must have proven experience working with Internet of Things (IoT) applications and platforms, along with

extensive hands-on expertise in both Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure.

The selected professional will take end-to-end technical ownership of projects, resolve complex engineering challenges,

guide development teams, and ensure the delivery of scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Take complete technical ownership of software projects, covering requirement analysis, technical planning,

solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.

• Independently architect, design, develop, integrate, and maintain enterprise-grade web applications, mobile

applications, APIs, and cloud-based services.

• Design intuitive, responsive, and user-friendly interfaces while ensuring consistent user experience, performance,

and accessibility.

• Develop robust frontend and backend applications, reusable components, scalable services, and secure integration

mechanisms.

• Architect, deploy, configure, secure, and manage production environments on both AWS and Microsoft Azure.

• Design and maintain databases, data processing pipelines, distributed systems, caching mechanisms, and highvolume data handling solutions.

• Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments, infrastructure automation, and application

release processes.

• Ensure system availability, performance, scalability, reliability, observability, and disaster recovery across

production environments.

• Design and implement secure, scalable IoT applications, including device connectivity, telemetry processing, realtime monitoring, and third-party platform integrations.

• Establish software engineering standards, conduct code reviews, implement automated testing, and ensure

application and infrastructure security.

• Independently investigate and resolve complex technical issues involving application performance, databases,

networking, cloud infrastructure, integrations, and production environments.

• Evaluate technology choices, define solution architectures, prepare technical documentation, and recommend

appropriate implementation approaches.

• Lead technical discussions, mentor engineers, coordinate development activities, and collaborate with

management and stakeholders to deliver business requirements.

Required Technical Skills

• Extensive hands-on proficiency in programming languages and modern application development technologies,

including Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and SQL.

• Strong practical experience with modern frameworks and technologies such as Angular, React, Next.js, Django,

FastAPI, Node.js, or equivalent platforms.

• Experience designing and developing web and mobile applications along with a strong understanding of UI/UX

principles and design tools.

• Expert-level knowledge of both AWS and Microsoft Azure, including cloud networking, compute, storage, identity

management, security, managed databases, serverless computing, container orchestration, monitoring, and

infrastructure architecture.

• Advanced experience with Linux server administration, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, GitHub

Actions, Azure DevOps, and automated deployment workflows.

• Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis, with

experience in database design, query optimization, replication, and data processing.

• Extensive understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, message

brokers, asynchronous processing, and third-party integrations.

• Proven experience designing scalable, highly available, fault-tolerant, and secure software solutions, including load

balancing, disaster recovery, and performance optimization.

• Strong experience with production monitoring, centralized logging, observability, incident management, and

troubleshooting using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, AWS CloudWatch, and Azure Monitor.

• Hands-on knowledge of software testing methodologies, automated testing frameworks, API testing, performance

testing, application security, and secure coding practices.

• Mandatory experience with IoT applications and platforms, including device connectivity, telemetry ingestion, IoT

cloud services, and communication protocols such as MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, UDP, LoRaWAN, NB-IoT, etc.

• Strong analytical ability, architectural decision-making, technical documentation, problem-solving, and leadership

skills.

**Eligibility Criteria**

• B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech/M.E., MCA, or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology,

Software Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Extensive professional experience in software engineering, including hands-on development, solution architecture,

cloud infrastructure, and technical leadership.

• Proven experience leading complex software projects and independently managing technical responsibilities

throughout the complete software development lifecycle.

• Demonstrated expertise in designing, deploying, operating, and troubleshooting production workloads on both

AWS and Microsoft Azure.

• Prior professional experience working on IoT-based products, platforms, or enterprise IoT integration solutions is

mandatory.

• Proven ability to independently design, develop, deploy, and maintain complete enterprise software solutions.

• Strong technical leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving capabilities.

Preferred Skills

• AWS and Microsoft Azure certifications in solution architecture, cloud engineering, DevOps, or related

specializations.

• Experience developing IoT solutions for smart metering, utilities, smart infrastructure, industrial systems, or device

management.

• Familiarity with LoRaWAN Network Servers (LNS), IoT gateways, communication protocols, and integration with

external IoT platforms.

• Experience working with multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud environments, large-scale distributed systems, and

enterprise security architectures.

• Knowledge of Generative AI, Large Language Models, AI-powered applications, and intelligent automation.

• Experience mentoring engineering teams, managing multiple technical initiatives, and providing technical guidance

across the software delivery lifecycle

title: SAP CPI
description:
**Position:**
SAP CPI / BTP Integration Consultant

**Experience:**
8–9 Years

**Location:**
Gurugram

**Work Mode:**
Work from Customer Office – 5 Days a Week

**Mandatory:**
At least 1–2 end-to-end implementation projects

**Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced SAP CPI / BTP Integration Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in SAP Integration Suite, Cloud Integration (CPI), API Management, and Open Connectors. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and supporting integrations between SAP S/4HANA, cloud applications, middleware platforms, and on-premise systems.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience with SAP CPI / SAP BTP Integration Suite.
* SAP API Management, API Portal, Business Hub, and Open Connectors.
* SAP Cloud Connector configuration and connectivity.
* CPI adapters: OData, SFTP, FTP, IDoc, RFC/BAPI, SOAP, HTTP, ProcessDirect, REST, AMQP, JDBC, and XI Proxy.
* Groovy and Java scripting.
* Message mapping, UDFs, and XSLT.
* WSDL, JSON, XML, XSD, and data conversion techniques such as JSON-to-XML and CSV-to-XML.
* Integration technologies including SAP PI/PO, CPI, EDI, ALE/IDoc, RFC/BAPI, and API-based integrations.
* Exception handling, monitoring, security artifacts, encryption/decryption, and retry mechanisms.
* CPI development and production support experience.
* Transport management using CTS+ or TMS.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* 8–9 years of relevant experience.
* At least 1–2 end-to-end SAP CPI integration implementations.
* Strong hands-on development experience with custom iFlows.
* Willingness to work from the customer office in Gurugram five days a week.
* Good communication, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder coordination skills.

📩 Apply Now! Drop your CV in the comments, DM us, or email at hr@runmapglobal.com

Engineers will utilize knowledge, skill and process to resolve client issues, while meeting all SLA targets, participating in continuous improvement processes, and utilizing Insight-provided tools and systems. Engineers are expected to participate in ITIL processes Incident, Problem, Request, Change, and will author and update knowledge articles and repeatable procedures to ensure junior teammates can independently resolve 80% of incident, without requiring escalation.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Serve as a senior technical escalation resource to junior teammates.
* Follows and reviews processes and procedures. Identify and correct gaps, recommend corrections. Fulfill technical engineering role as client and business needs demand.
* Mentor and coach engineering and technical level resources. Helps to develop service catalog. Conducts and presents knowledge transfer on regular cadence.
* Provides technical resolution or request fulfillment of assigned tickets.
* Drives problem management to reduce incident volumes due to recurrent issues.
* Creates and updates knowledge articles to aid in incident resolution, and request fulfillment efforts.
* Makes recommendations for client-specific technology improvements, and reports on lifecycle and system health of devices in a client environment.
* Lead problem identification and management efforts including root cause analysis, known error records, etc, and is a member of an on-call rotation.
* Adheres to service-wide SLAs and is subject to an on-call rotation.

**Key Technical Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher, focusing on IT, Network Engineering, or other related studies.
* Seven or more years of demonstrated experience providing technical support for common enterprise networking vendors to include, but not limited to: Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto, Fprtinet, Aruba, F5. Supporting technologies including, but not limited to: routing, switching, firewalls, wireless access, VPN, SDWan, and MPLS.
* SME-level understanding and capability within Cisco IOS and CLI, Aruba Central, FortiManager, Cisco Meraki, Cisco Umbrella, Cisco ISE, Palo Alto Prisma, Cisco Catalyst Center Manager, and similar enterprise vendor toolsets.
* Maintain one or more professional level certifications (CCNP or equivalent), working to obtain an expert-level certification.

* Freedom to work from another location—even an international destination—for up to 30 consecutive calendar days per year.

But what really sets us apart are our core values of Hunger, Heart, and Harmony, which guide everything we do, from building relationships with teammates, partners, and clients to making a positive impact in our communities.

title: Principal Platform Engineer (High Availability & Disaster Recovery)
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

Principle 

Platform 

DR & Capacity

 

Engineer

 

 

At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

 

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

 

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

 

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

 

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

 

 

Your 

impact

 

As the Principal HA & DR Engineer, you will own the architectural strategy and technical execution for the platform's resilience, high availability, and disaster recovery lifecycle. You will design, build, and 

deliver

 technical solutions that support Platform

 availability, resiliency, and 

disaster response

.

 

You will act as the principal authority for business continuity across our global infrastructure, defining the guardrails for system fault-tolerance and leading cross-functional coordination for multi-region disaster preparedness

 between both cloud and on prem

. You will also design automated failover mechanisms, champion chaos engineering practices, and develop robust mitigation strategies to eliminate single points of failure across both cloud and on-premises infrastructure.

 

 

 

 

 

 

**You will :**

 

* Drive the HA Strategy & Roadmap: Own the end-to-end design and technical execution of our global High Availability roadmap, ensuring continuous platform uptime across both cloud and on-premises environments.

* Build & Implement HA Architectures: Hand-on code, configure, and engineer active-active clustering, global load balancing, and real-time database replication to completely eliminate single points of failure.

* Establish the Resiliency Practice: Build and champion our foundational Resiliency Engineering framework from scratch, defining platform-wide standards for fault tolerance and self-healing.

* Influence Engineering Teams: Partner with and influence cross-functional engineering squads to ensure self-healing mechanisms and automated recovery protocols are embedded directly into their core deliverables.

* Bootstrap Chaos Engineering: Introduce and champion our first-ever Chaos Engineering program; you will define the strategy, establish the safe guardrails, and prepare the organization to execute its initial automated fault-injection and live-fire failover drills.

* Build & Implement HA Architectures: Hand-on code, configure, and engineer active-active clustering, global load balancing, and real-time database replication to completely eliminate single points of failure.

* Optimize Uptime & Manage Risks: Monitor infrastructure performance KPIs to identify potential bottlenecks, mitigate shortage or overload risks before they cause downtime, and ensure compliance with strict Customer SLA requirements.

 

Your skills and experience

 

We work with a broad range of technologies, and we don’t expect you to know everything on day one. You’ll have time to learn our tools and grow into the role. We're looking for diverse experiences to help strengthen our team.


 

Essential

 

* 8+ Years of HA Engineering: Extensive HA experience across cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and on-premises environments.

* Technical Influence: Proven ability to evangelize resiliency standards and influence cross-functional engineering teams to build self-healing features.

* Failover & Replication: Hands-on expertise with real-time data replication, database clustering, and automated, zero-downtime traffic failover.

* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Advanced proficiency with Terraform or Ansible to build and replicate highly available environments programmatically.

* Systems & Container Engineering: Deep technical knowledge of Linux internals and container orchestration using Kubernetes (K8s).

* Hybrid Network Engineering: Hands-on experience managing complex hybrid networking topologies, including BGP routing, DNS management, Anycast, and CDNs.

*   Strategic Execution: Ability to translate high-level uptime requirements into a technical roadmap and personally execute the engineering work.

Desirable

 

* Experience supporting SaaS products.

* Experience with Incident Management, Post Mortems and related practices.

* Knowledge of observability and monitoring best practices.

* Experience operating within one or more public clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure).

* Experience with configuration management, and infrastructure as code

* Knowledge of observability and monitoring best practices

 

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)**

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:

* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

**Privacy & AI

Notice**

C

andidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled

in accordance with

our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to

assist

our team in evaluating qualifications.

title: EDS Consultant
description: Job Description Title Technical Consultant EDS Department Enterprise Technology Services Location India - Flexible Reports To Mohamed Guizani Level Senior Technical Consultant Were proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like youre part of something bigger. About your team The Enterprise Directory Services (EDS) team engineers and manages solutions and infrastructure supporting Fidelitys global enterprise directory services and identity & access management, including Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID. About your role Youll join the EDS team as a hands-on engineer focused on day-to-day operations and security hardening across Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD). You will work with platform SMEs and the wider team to deliver BAU tickets, implement hardening baselines, and execute engineering changes. The emphasis is on collaboration and deliverycontributing expert work under established standards and designs rather than owning product roadmaps or leading programs. About you In this role, you will be responsible for efficiently triaging and resolving incidents, service requests, and standard changes across AD/Entra ID, PKI, AD FS, and Quest Active Roles, ensuring adherence to SLAs. You will implement Tier-0/DC hardening, manage GPO governance, and enhance security through Kerberos/LDAP protections and Conditional Access/PIM controls. Your engineering expertise will be pivotal in executing changes based on SME/architect designs, utilising PowerShell and Microsoft Graph for automation and configuration management. You will conduct security remediation using tools like BloodHound/AzureHound and PingCastle, whilst also contributing to monitoring, ops quality, and compliance processes. Collaboration with SMEs and various teams is essential, alongside actively participating in major-incident support and knowledge sharing. Experience & qualifications Microsoft Identity Expertise Strong hands-on experience with Active Directory, Entra ID (Azure AD), AD FS, and Azure AD Connect, including AD 2016/2019 design, troubleshooting, and administration. Privileged Access & Security Solid understanding of AD security (Tier-0/Tier-1, PAWs), lateral movement risks, and secure PAW/jump server rollout. Hardening & Governance Skilled in applying CIS-aligned baselines, securing domain controllers, GPO design, service account hygiene, and identity governance. Cloud Identity & Access Controls Experienced with Conditional Access, MFA, device/risk-based policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and secure Entra ID operations at scale. Automation & Tooling Proficient with PowerShell, Graph API, Terraform, KQL, and automation frameworks for audits, enforcement, and remediation; hands-on with BloodHound, PingCastle, and identity monitoring tools. Protocols, Standards & Communication Strong grasp of OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, PKI/AD CS, and Windows security standards; clear communicator with ability to engage both technical and senior stakeholders.

title: Senior Service Operations Specialist
description:
**Overview**
**WELCOME TO SITA**
SITA is the leading specialist in air transport communications and information technology. We don’t just connect the global aviation industry, we apply decades of experience and expertise to address almost every core business, operational, baggage, and passenger process in air transport. As an organization, we cover 95% of all international air travel destinations and work with over 2,800 air transport and government customers in every corner of the globe. Immerse yourself in the dynamic world of technology while embracing our collaborative, and inclusive culture.
  
  
***Ready to redefine air travel? The journey starts here, with you at SITA.***
**About The Role & Team**
This is an exciting opportunity to become an integral part of an experienced and smart SITA GNCC team. The role is a Sr. Specialist role, responsible for operational fault management for SITA-managed LAN / WAN & security solutions. An ideal candidate will be monitoring and managing the airport LAN/WAN, Network Security along with local and wide area networks for the SITA customer environment to ensure maximum uptime.
  
  
The role includes Level 2/3 technical support, troubleshooting, configurations, documentation, network optimization and management of the LAN/WAN/ Security infrastructure, The candidate will also maintain and upgrade existing systems as necessary. The ability to work in a complex networking environment is also preferred.
  
  
You will be apart of an excellent and innovative team , reporting to the Senior Manager Service operations.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Responsible for Network troubleshooting including LAN, WAN & Security domains
* Responsible for responding to technical support calls from SITA customers.
* Implementation, Deployment, L2/L3 Support for network devices, LAN, WAN, Firewall, Network troubleshooting/ configuration etc.
* Troubleshoot & resolve highly complex customer network & security issues
* Experience in troubleshooting Cisco routers, switches & firewalls (ASA, Palo Alto)
* Handling CISCO L3 and L2 Devices
* Strong working knowledge of Datacenter switching e.g., Cisco Nexus, ACI.
* Strong working knowledge of the following routing protocols: BGP, OSPF; and optional for EIGRP, RIP.
* Experience in using WAN circuits, e.g., Metro Ethernet, MPLS. VPLS etc.
* Strong working knowledge of IP, IPsec, and VPNs.
* Responsible for delivering complex Maintenance and Monitoring activities for different customers.
* Provide L3 Incident Management support through the IC role in case of the major crisis.
* Ensure service continuity by reducing the impact of a disaster or major failure through operational validation of the designed
* Perform network maintenance and system upgrades including service packs, patches, hot fixes and security configurations
* Experience in network automation through scripting languages such as Python Ansible, Jason etc. is a plus.
* Monitor performance and ensure system availability and reliability
* Monitor system resource utilization, trending, and capacity planning
* Ensure that assigned infrastructure at the client site is configured, installed, tested and operational.
* Identify problems and errors prior to or when they occur and log all such incidents in a timely manner with the required level of detail.
* Managing and maintaining the operational integrity of the company's security and data networks and will be required to respond to incidents and alerts and provide occasional out-of-hours technical support.
* Leverage knowledge articles to investigate and resolve second-line support calls assigned
* Provide remote support to SITA clients.
* Identify the root cause of incidents and problems. Prepare RCA for business-critical incidents and downtime
* Work within established configuration and change management policies to ensure awareness, approval and success of changes made to the network infrastructure
* Schedule updates for customer services.
* Perform troubleshooting and incident management for high-priority issues and ensure that they are resolved within the timeframes set by service level agreements.
* Handle customers’ technical enquiries as well as service-related enquiries.
* Provide insights and recommendations regarding customers’ networks and their optimization.
* Support knowledge sharing and training, both internally and with customer teams.

**Qualifications**
**EXPERIENCE**

* At least 5 years of experience in the Information Technology / Telecom Industry.
* Strong customer focus, able to respond quickly and effectively to customers’ requests, and able to adapt to a fast-changing customer landscape and challenges.
* Must have experience to work in a 24\*7 support environment.
* Hands-on experience with monitoring, Network diagnostic and analytics tools
* Experience working with virtual and remote team members and stakeholders
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent data presentation and reporting skills.
* Working Experience on enterprise customers projects: Network & Security Solutions
* Must have a strong understanding of Firewalls Architecture with hands-on experience.
* Must have strong experience with Complex Routing & Switching Environments
* Must possess strong experience with Virtualization Technologies
* Good problem-solving skills
* Good at organizing and multitasking
* Able to explain technical problems in simple terms
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Experience in implementing network patches
* Degree or equivalent experience in Engineering, Computer Technologies, or Business
* Change management/ Project Management knowledge (ITIL knowledge is a plus)
* Proficiency in English is a must

**One Or More Additional Certifications Are Required**

* CCNA, CCNP
* JNCIA
* PCNSA/E
* Cisco 300-415 ENSDWI
* ITILV4

**What We Offer**
We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
  
  
🏡
**Flex Week:**
Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)
  
  
⏰
**Flex Day:**
Make your workday suit your life and plans.
  
  
🌎

🌿

We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
  
  
🚀

Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning!
  
  
🙌

**Preferred Attributes**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.

title: NETWORK ENGINEER
description:
Tejaki — by Blowtrumpet Technologies
  
  

* South Delhi
* Full-time / Intern / Early Career

**ABOUT Tejaki**
Tejaki is Blowtrumpet’s publisher-facing supply-side platform (SSP), built for content creators who want transparent monetisation. Tejaki runs on offers — not blind bids — so creators know what they are earning and why. It supports multiple content formats and fair revenue distribution. Tejaki is a product under Blowtrumpet Technologies.
  
  
THE ROLE
  
  
Build and maintain the network infrastructure for content delivery, publisher API connectivity, and payout-system reliability — ensuring creators experience fast, secure, and uninterrupted service.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Design, deploy, and manage server infrastructure on leased bare metal in India
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and rollback procedures
* Manage hardware procurement, rack configuration, and data-centre relationships
* Scale infrastructure — load balancing, auto-scaling, capacity planning, and traffic management
* Implement DevOps practices — infrastructure-as-code, GitOps, observability, and incident response
* Harden security — firewall management, intrusion detection, VPN configuration, and access controls

**What We Are Looking For**

* Strong Linux system administration and networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, BGP, VLANs)
* Hands-on experience with bare-metal server management and data-centre operations
* Proficiency with Docker, Kubernetes (or K3s), and infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Ansible)
* Experience with CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins)

title: Senior Network Operations Engineer
description:
**The Role**

The Senior Network Operations Engineer is responsible for the deployment, operations, and continuous improvement of Megaport’s global network infrastructure. This role plays a critical part in building, expanding, and maintaining highly scalable, reliable, and resilient network services that customers depend on.

Working closely with Network Architects, Infrastructure, and Customer Support teams, you will contribute to expanding the global network footprint, increasing capacity, and ensuring operational excellence across the infrastructure.

This role requires strong expertise in large-scale network deployments, network operations, and troubleshooting, with a focus on automation, performance optimisation, and customer experience.

You will collaborate with global stakeholders, data centre providers, and carriers to deliver new infrastructure, resolve complex network challenges, and maintain high network availability.

***This is not an entry-level role. Candidates must have 3+ years of similar CORE network engineering experience within the network services industry.***

**About Megaport**

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

**Our Team Culture**

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.

We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Design, analyse, test, and deploy new network sites and infrastructure.
* Plan and execute network deployments and upgrades.
* Plan and execute data centre onboarding, PoP deployments, and network equipment installations.
* Configure and deploy enterprise networking equipment (Cisco and Juniper) via secure remote methods.
* Design, implement, and test Cloud On-Ramp connectivity with providers such as AWS, Azure, and Oracle.
* Design, implement, and validate global network circuits.
* Operate and maintain the next-generation global network infrastructure.
* Provide Level 3 escalation support for major network incidents and customer-impacting issues.
* Support Network Operations Centre (NOC) teams during incident mitigation and troubleshooting.
* Identify the root causes of network issues and implement preventive measures.
* Document operational procedures and completed work in internal systems.
* Actively monitor, plan and execute network capacity management initiatives.
* Support network risk management and resilience improvements.
* Identify opportunities to redesign the network to optimise performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Execute assigned procurement activities to ensure adherence to network design standards.
* Perform carrier and vendor technical analysis.
* Manage assigned network deployment and infrastructure projects end-to-end.
* Coordinate with engineering, deployment, and operations teams to ensure successful delivery.
* Provide regular reporting on network performance, deployments, and infrastructure growth.
* Contribute to technical documentation, SOPs, and operational processes.
* Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior engineers and operations teams.
* Contribute to the development of training materials for Network Operations staff.
* Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex infrastructure issues.
* Work closely with other departments across Megaport (e.g., Network/Infrastructure, Engineering, Procurement/Suppliers as relevant) to achieve shared business goals.
* Enhance integration between Megaport teams to reduce resolution times, enhance accountability, and improve customer outcomes.
* Advocate for the customer internally by turning feedback and recurring issues into clear, prioritised improvement initiatives.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 6+ years of experience working with large-scale network deployments and operations
* Strong experience with routing and MPLS technologies, including BGP, ISIS, MPLS Traffic Engineering, and MPLS L2/L3 VPN
* Production experience with Juniper and Cisco network platforms
* Experience deploying and troubleshooting data centre network infrastructure
* Experience working with fibre optic technologies and DWDM environments
* Familiarity with cloud networking and SDN concepts
* Experience with Python, Perl, Linux environments or similar scripting languages is highly desirable
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
* Ability to work independently and across distributed teams
* Proactive and self-motivated with a continuous improvement mindset
* Strong focus on delivering an excellent customer experience

**Team Fit**

* Able to work autonomously within a globally dispersed team environment, managing competing priorities with minimal supervision.
* Strong work ethic, reliable follow-through, and consistent accountability for outcomes.
* Team player who enjoys collaboration, contributes ideas, and is comfortable mentoring and coaching others.
* Passion for innovation and technology, with an interest in staying current across evolving ISP and cloud landscapes.
* Planning & Project Delivery
* Strong organisation and prioritisation skills; effectively plans and manages workload in a fast-paced operational environment.
* Exposure to running projects effectively is essential (driving initiatives across process, tooling, reporting, service improvements, or training uplift).

**What We Offer**

* \*Subject to the internal policies of Megaport, which may be updated from time to time\*:
* Family health insurance according to company policy
* A motivated team combining industry experts and emerging talent.
* Recognition programs – including Legend and Kudos Awards.

**Working Conditions, Location and Hours**

* Full-time office-based role, at our Gurugram office
* The working day is 8 hours, and the working week is 40 hours.
* Working visits to the Locations which are under your responsibility for meeting partners, vendors, team, checking the quality of the network
* 90-day notice period for resignation after the trial period
* Working exclusively for Extreme Infocom Pvt. Ltd. and not for any other companies.

If you have any questions, please reach out to Megaport's Talent Acquisition Team at Careers@megaport.com

If you have any concerns, please reach out to Megaport's careers team careers@megaport.com directly and we will verify the legitimacy of any communication. Megaport will not ask you to create an account via Microsoft teams, and does not associate with any email accounts under "@megaportau.com".***

title: Technical Services Engineer
description:
MongoDB’s mission is to empower innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries by unleashing the power of software and data. We enable organizations of all sizes to easily build, scale, and run modern applications by helping them modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our industry-leading developer data platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud database and is available in more than 115 regions across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. Atlas allows customers to build and run applications anywhere—on premises, or across cloud providers. With offices worldwide and over 175,000 new developers signing up to use MongoDB every month, it’s no wonder that leading organizations, like Samsung and Toyota, trust MongoDB to build next-generation, AI-powered applications.
  
  
MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem - database server, drivers, cloud, and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork, and a great sense of humor to help our customers be successful with MongoDB.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. The position will be based in our Gurugram office. The standard work week will be Sunday to Thursday, every week.
  
  
Cool things you’ll do
  
  
You'll be working alongside our largest customers, solving their complex challenges - resolving questions on architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between. You'll be an expert resource on best practices in running MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You'll be an advocate for customers' needs - interfacing with our product management and development teams on their behalf. And you'll contribute to internal projects, including software development of support tools for performance, benchmarking, and diagnostics.
  
  
What you need
  
  
You should have 5+ years of proven experience, we consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self-taught, insatiably curious, and multi-faceted.
  
  
The ideal candidates should have strong technical experience in more than one of the following areas
  
  

* Systems engineering experience, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, networking, clusters, and troubleshooting
* Understand core Kubernetes concepts, including containers, namespaces, custom resources and multi-cluster deployments
* Should have a good understanding of Networking concepts and protocols (DNS, TCP/IP, SSL/TLS, etc.)
* Storage engineering experience, including NAS, SAN, SSD, multi-pathing, and caching
* Experience building and maintaining complex mission-critical production database systems
* Broad awareness of customer workloads and use cases, including performance, availability, and scalability
* Experience analyzing issues holistically, from the application tier through the database, down to the storage
* Be able to read code, and basic coding/scripting ability in one or more languages: Java, Python, Ruby, C, C++, C#, Javascript, node.js, Go, etc.
* Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills

If you have an operations background, we prefer experience administering large-scale production environments, including hardware, operating systems (e.g. Linux, Windows), networks (including firewalls and load balancers), as well as cloud-based resources (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform).
  
  
You should possess a genuine desire to help people, the ability to think on your feet and remain calm under pressure while solving problems in real-time. There’s a lot to learn, so the desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills is paramount. We work in a collaborative team environment, so a willingness and ability to get help from team members when required, and good judgment to know when to seek help, is essential. We also aim to have diverse technical backgrounds and therefore different subject matter expertise is welcome.
  
  
*You do not need to have prior experience with MongoDB. We can teach you that!*
Bonus Points
  
  

* Experience managing large scale databases (e.g. RDBMS, NoSQL)
* Experience with authentication systems such as LDAP, Kerberos, AD
* Experience using or managing MongoDB
* Experience using distributed version control systems, and in particular git
* Experience using any cloud services stack such as AWS, Azure or GCP
* Experience with virtualization, Docker, Kubernetes (including CLI), ability to inspect resource / container status using relevant utilities and commands

Success Measures
  
  

* In 3 months, you’ll have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its ecosystem. You will complete New Hire Training.
* In 6 months, you will be comfortable working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam.
* In 12 months, you will work on gaining expertise to be a part of a technical experts group within MongoDB and will be helping your peer engineers in advance diagnostics. Also, you will be encouraged to handle technical escalations independently.

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

**Scope**
We are seeking a highly accomplished
**Principal Engineer**
to serve as the technical authority and architectural leader for our cloud-native platform and infrastructure within the Financial Platform organization. In this role, you will define the platform architecture roadmap, design mission-critical infrastructure patterns, and lead the technical execution of platforms that power large-scale, distributed financial applications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Platform Architecture & Strategic Direction: Define and drive the target-state architecture for our next-generation, cloud-native platform (Kubernetes, multi-region cloud topologies, and AI/workload enablement). Translate overarching business goals into scalable, resilient, and decoupled platform capabilities.
* Hands-On Core Engineering: Lead by example by writing production-grade code, building foundational custom tooling/operators (Golang, Python), authoring reusable Terraform modules, and designing reference implementations for engineering teams.
* Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Serve as a mentor and technical coach to junior and mid-level engineers. Facilitate design reviews, establish architecture RFC processes, conduct deep code/infrastructure reviews, and foster a strong culture of engineering excellence.
* Container Platforms & Orchestration: Architect resilient, multi-cluster Kubernetes topologies at scale. Define best practices for workload scheduling, networking (service mesh), custom controllers/operators, GitOps workflows (ArgoCD/Flux), and multi-tenant isolation.
* Enterprise CI/CD & Developer Experience (DevEx): Architect automated, self-service golden paths and progressive delivery pipelines (canary, blue-green) that minimize cognitive load for application developers while ensuring strict deployment guardrails.
* Zero-Trust Security & Policy-as-Code: Embed DevSecOps at the architectural level—designing policy-as-code frameworks (OPA/Kyverno), centralized secrets management (HashiCorp Vault), secure supply chain standards (SBOM, image signing, Trivy), and compliance baselines (SOC 2, ISO 27001).
* Observability, SRE & Chaos Engineering: Design holistic telemetry strategies utilizing OpenTelemetry. Define enterprise SLI/SLO standards, error budget policies, resilience testing/chaos engineering, and lead complex root-cause analyses (RCA) for critical production incidents.
* FinOps & Performance Optimization: Architect cost-efficient cloud topologies. Establish capacity planning models, multi-region traffic routing, right-sizing strategies, and automated cost-governance guardrails.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience: 7+ years of hands-on experience in Platform Engineering, SRE, Distributed Systems, or Cloud Architecture, with a proven track record of designing and operating large-scale, production-grade distributed systems.
* Architecture & System Design: Demonstrated expertise in architecting complex, highly available, fault-tolerant, and secure cloud topologies (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Deep Hands-on Coding & Automation: Proficiency in at least one modern systems programming language (e.g., Golang, Python) along with advanced scripting (Bash). Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and systems software design.
* Infrastructure-as-Code Mastery: Expert-level proficiency with Terraform(custom provider/module development, state locking, drift detection) and Policy-as-Code engines (e.g., OPA, Rego, Kyverno).
* Kubernetes Internals: Comprehensive understanding of Kubernetes internals (control plane components, CNI/CSI, custom controllers/operators, RBAC, API extensions, and scheduling primitives).
* Mentorship & Influence: Proven track record of guiding junior engineers, driving engineering consensus across disparate teams, and leading technical initiatives without direct authority.
