title: Support Engineer - Level 1
description:
**Your Role**

This is an exciting opportunity for a Support Engineer (L1) to solve real-world networking challenges while collaborating with global teams. In this role, you’ll be the first line of response to customer-reported issues, taking ownership of tickets, performing essential diagnostics, and delivering exceptional support experiences. You’ll work both independently and collaboratively in a dynamic environment that values reliability, proactive monitoring, and continuous learning. This position is ideal for a motivated engineer looking to build their career within a global technology company that fosters a strong engineering culture and a supportive, customer-focused team.

As a Support Engineer (L1), your primary responsibility involves efficiently addressing customer concerns communicated through tickets, live chat, and calls, ensuring clear and effective communication to understand and resolve issues promptly. Additionally, you’ll be responsible for the proactive monitoring of our systems and services to identify and rectify potential problems before they impact operations. When faced with complex or high-severity issues, you will gather essential diagnostics and seek guidance from Senior Support Engineers to ensure swift and accurate escalations. Your consistent presence across our shift rotations, ensuring coverage 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, underlines our commitment to providing uninterrupted support and maintaining operational continuity at all times.

**About Megaport**

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

**Our Team Culture**

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.

We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* **Customer Support & Service Excellence**
* Deliver exceptional technical support and customer service via phone, email, and live chat. Process incoming customer calls promptly following ticket submissions to clarify issues, address queries, and ensure accurate understanding.
* Skillfully assess and prioritize tickets based on urgency and operational impact, ensuring critical issues receive immediate attention.
* Maintain high customer satisfaction by resolving issues at the first point of contact whenever possible and keeping customers informed throughout the process.
* Meet or exceed defined KPIs and SLAs while adhering to established operating procedures and policies.
* Strive to independently resolve customer concerns at the first point of contact, escalating complex technical issues to Senior Support Engineers (L2) only when appropriate.
* Manage escalations between global teams (e.g., acting as a bridge between regional support teams) to ensure seamless communication and timely resolution.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customers’ services or improve their overall experience.
* **Service Monitoring & Incident Response**
* Proactively monitor company services, network ports, and peering platforms using alerting and incident response tools to ensure high availability and stability.
* Process alert logs, detect anomalies, and take immediate corrective measures, including opening vendor or customer tickets when necessary.
* Perform system initialization post-server reboots, verifying that traffic restores to pre-reboot baselines and escalating timely if performance inconsistencies occur.
* Create and update detailed incident reports, maintaining accurate, real-time updates on status pages for customer transparency.
* Regularly monitor aggregated content and performance graphs to track trends and identify potential service degradation.
* Process maintenance notifications (internal and external).
* **Knowledge Sharing**
* Contribute to building and maintaining an integrated internal knowledge base by documenting known issues, standard operating procedures, and basic troubleshooting guides.
* Maintain high-quality documentation for designs, configurations, known issues, troubleshooting procedures, and post-incident learnings to enable repeatable outcomes and team uplift.
* Learn and adopt new systems, monitoring applications, and support tools introduced across integrated global operations.

**Your Success Metrics**

* **Installation Efficiency & Quality**
* Track the number, timeliness, and success rate of service installations.
* Maintain a high first-time success rate, minimising rework or follow-up visits.
* Collect and analyse customer feedback post-installation to gauge satisfaction and identify areas for improvement.
* **Ticket & Alert Resolution Performance**
* Achieve a high percentage of received tickets and alerts resolved without further escalation.
* Achieve a strong First Time Resolution rate.
* Ensure essential diagnostic checks and detailed internal notes are completed for 100% of handled tickets within SLA timeframes.
* Ensure that all issues undergo thorough diagnostic checks before being resolved or escalated.
* Maintain strong adherence to KPIs and SLAs for response and resolution times.
* Quickly prioritize, categorize, and process monitoring alerts within target timelines, ensuring service-impacting events are properly communicated and documented.
* Maintain 100% accuracy in incident reports and status page updates to ensure full transparency for customers and internal teams.
* Aim for high first-contact resolution and reduced case reopen rates.

**What We Are Looking For**

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong foundational understanding of network infrastructure and protocols, including LAN/WAN fundamentals (Ethernet, switches, VLANs, IP addressing, ASN, prefixes, and BGP basics).
* Hands-on experience with a variety of network equipment (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Nokia, MikroTik, and similar platforms).
* Good understanding of networking protocols, including MPLS, OSPF, BGP, and other advanced routing protocols.
* Familiarity with network hardware platforms and tools used in technical support and network monitoring operations.
* Proven experience in logical troubleshooting and resolving networking issues (minimum of three years).

**Customer Support & Problem-Solving**

* Exceptional ability to assess, prioritise, and resolve customer issues efficiently while maintaining clear and professional communication.
* Strong customer service orientation with a focus on understanding customer needs and delivering effective solutions.
* Proven ability to monitor services proactively, detect anomalies, and take corrective action to maintain stability and reliability.

**Communication & Collaboration**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with global teams while also working independently when required.
* Team-oriented mindset with a focus on cooperation, mutual support, and shared success.
* Strong interpersonal skills to build positive relationships with customers and colleagues across regions.

**Personal Attributes**

* Detail-oriented, organised, and committed to delivering high-quality results.
* Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced technical environment.
* High flexibility and readiness to work in a 24/7 rotational shift environment (including night shifts and weekends).

**Working Hours**

* **Office-based role:**
  Sector 26, Gurgaon Delhi, Gurugram, Haryana
* **Schedule:**
  8.5 hours per shift
* You will be scheduled to work on weekends, public holiday and night shifts in a rotating cycle
* Working visits to the Locations which are under your responsibility for meeting partners, vendors, team, checking the quality of the network
* 90-day notice period for resignation after the trial period
* Working exclusively for Extreme Infocom Pvt. Ltd. and not for any other companies.

**What We Offer**

title: Network Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

**We are looking for a technically competent and service-oriented IT Professional to support IT infrastructure, network administration, endpoint security, and day-to-day IT operations at designated client offices.**

**The ideal candidate should have a sound understanding of networking fundamentals, practical experience in IT/ITES projects, and the ability to troubleshoot technical issues while maintaining secure, reliable, and efficient IT infrastructure.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Network Administration & Infrastructure**

**Support the design, implementation, configuration, and maintenance of secure and segmented network infrastructure.**

**Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot routers, switches, firewalls, and related network devices (e.g. Zyxel, Cisco)**

**Manage and support LAN/WAN connectivity, VLANs, VPNs, and network segmentation.**

**Troubleshoot network connectivity issues and help maintain network availability.**

**2. IT Support & Troubleshooting**

**Provide frontline technical support for end-user devices, network connectivity, and endpoint security issues.**

**Diagnose and resolve IT incidents and service requests within the assigned scope.**

**Escalate complex or unresolved technical issues to the appropriate authority.**

**Maintain records of reported issues, actions taken, and resolutions.**

**3. Server & IT Infrastructure Management**

**Assist in managing server infrastructure and routine IT infrastructure operations.**

**Support system patching, asset tracking, access control, and operational maintenance.**

**Maintain IT asset inventories and update relevant infrastructure records.**

**Follow approved procedures for system maintenance and configuration changes.**

**4. Information Security & Access Control**

**Support endpoint security and implementation of approved security practices.**

**Follow access control policies, patch management processes, and IT security guidelines.**

**Protect confidential information and prevent unauthorised access, disclosure, or transfer of data.**

**Report security incidents, suspicious activities, and potential vulnerabilities through the prescribed channels.**

**5. Network Monitoring & Documentation**

**Use network monitoring tools to identify connectivity issues and infrastructure anomalies.**

**Maintain technical documentation, asset registers, configuration records, and support logs.**

**Assist in maintaining operational hygiene and continuity of IT services.**

**6. Client Coordination & Compliance**

**Coordinate with designated client officials and team members for day-to-day IT support activities.**

**Follow client policies, workplace discipline, attendance requirements, and reporting procedures.**

**Undertake related duties assigned by the Regional Head, within the scope of the role and applicable qualifications.**

**Maintain professional conduct, confidentiality, and service quality at all times.**

**Educational Qualification**

**B.Tech. / B.E., MCA, M.Sc. in Information Technology or Computer Science, MS in Software System**

**Work Experience**

**Minimum one year of experience in IT or IT-enabled services (ITES) projects.**

**Technical Certification**

**Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) or an equivalent**

**Essential Technical Skills**

* Networking fundamentals and network architecture.
* TCP/IP, IP addressing, subnetting, DNS, and DHCP.
* Routing, switching, VLANs, VPNs, and network segmentation.
* Basic configuration and troubleshooting of routers, switches, and firewalls (e.g. Zyxel, Cisco).
* Understanding of server infrastructure and endpoint security.
* Knowledge of patch management, asset tracking, and access control.
* Network monitoring and systematic troubleshooting.

title: Infrastructure Engineer (Compute)
description:
**About Revolut**
People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.
  
  
As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
  
  
**About The Role**
Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.
  
  
We’re looking for an Infrastructure Engineer (Compute) to design and build core systems that manage containerised and virtualised workloads running on bare-metal and hybrid environments. This role is ideal for engineers who love working close to the kernel, building tools that abstract hardware complexity, and optimising infrastructure for scale and speed.
  
  
Up for the challenge? Let’s get in touch.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Designing and maintaining compute layer, focusing Kubernetes on bare metal
* Developing infrastructure-agnostic tooling and APIs to manage hybrid cloud environments at scale
* Ensuring infrastructure reliability through proactive detection/remediation of hardware failures and auto-healing
* Managing hardware lifecycle, from procurement and installation to decommissioning and upgrades
* Collaborating closely with network, security, and DevOps teams to ensure seamless integration between physical infrastructure and public cloud
* Documenting infrastructure processes, configurations, and best practices

**What You'll Need**

* 5+ years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages
* 3+ years of experience managing physical hardware
* Experience with Kubernetes on bare metal and open-source storage solutions (Ceph, MinIO)
* Experience automating infrastructure tasks using Infrastructure-as-Code tools
* Deep knowledge of data center operations, including power distribution, cooling, and rack management
* Familiarity with server hardware and storage systems (Dell, HP, Supermicro)
* Solid troubleshooting and problem-solving skills related to hardware failures and performance bottlenecks
* Expertise in one or more object-oriented programming languages (Go, Java, Python)
* An academic background in STEM

**Nice to have**

* Professional certifications (e.g., CCNP, CKA, Google Cloud, Red Hat)
* Experience working in regulated environments (financial services)
* Familiarity with security best practices and compliance frameworks (PCI DSS, SOC2, GDPR)

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.
  
  
**Important notice for candidates:**
Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.
  
  

* Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
* Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

description:
**Job title:**
**Engineer - Controls & Automation**
**Location:**
**Delhi/NCR**
**About Us**
Ingersoll Rand is a Fortune 500 company with a passion for making lives better. We do this by living our values, and through a relentless focus on the success of our customers and partnering with our employees to think and act like owners. We believe in sustainability through the development and distribution of a broad range of global brands designed to meet the needs of our customers in both efficient and responsible ways. Ingersoll Rand is a diverse and inclusive environment. For more information visit: www.irco.com.
  
  
**Job Overview**
Experienced PLC and Field Communication Engineer with expertise in industrial automation, control systems, and communication networks. Skilled in PLC programming, commissioning, troubleshooting, and integrating field devices with SCADA/DCS systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, program, and commission PLC-based automation systems for power tools, lifting equipment, and industrial manufacturing applications.
* Configure, troubleshoot, and optimize PLC platforms including Siemens, Mitsubishi, Allen-Bradley, and Schneider Electric controllers.
* Integrate PLC systems with SCADA, HMI, DCS, and Industrial IoT platforms to enable real-time monitoring, diagnostics, and control.
* Configure and maintain industrial communication networks utilizing protocols such as Modbus RTU/TCP, Profibus, Profinet, Ethernet/IP, and OPC.
* Support installation, commissioning, startup, and validation activities for automation and control systems at customer sites and manufacturing facilities.
* Perform fault diagnosis, root cause analysis, and corrective actions related to PLC programs, control panels, field devices, and communication networks.
* Ensure reliable communication between PLCs, VFDs, sensors, actuators, lifting equipment controllers, and other field devices.
* Configure and troubleshoot industrial Ethernet infrastructure, managed switches, wireless communication systems, and remote connectivity solutions.
* Assist in the development and implementation of automation standards, control philosophies, and network architecture guidelines.
* Conduct preventive maintenance and health checks of automation hardware, communication networks, and field instrumentation.
* Calibrate, test, and validate field instruments, sensors, encoders, load cells, limit switches, and safety devices used in lifting and material handling systems.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance equipment uptime, productivity, safety, and process efficiency.
* Participate in FAT (Factory Acceptance Testing), SAT (Site Acceptance Testing), and customer demonstrations for automation solutions.
* Ensure compliance with industrial safety standards, electrical regulations, and Ingersoll Rand quality requirements during project execution and service activities.
* Provide technical support and training to customers, service engineers, and internal stakeholders on automation systems and communication networks.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s in Mechatronics/Electrical or Electronics & Communications.
* 4-6 years relevant experience in Industrial Automation domain.
* Good level of English, spoken and written
* Hands-on experience in commissioning and maintenance of automated equipment, lifting systems, material handling equipment, or manufacturing machinery.
* Strong troubleshooting skills in both control systems and industrial communication networks.
* Willingness to travel for installation, commissioning, and customer support activities.

**Core Competencies**

* Result Oriented
* Self-motivator and Self Starter
* Customer oriented
* Problem Solving skills
* Capability to understand and synthesize of customer issues
* Communication skills
* Good team player

**Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements**

* 70-80% Travel (As and When required)

**What We Offer**

* We are all owners of the company! Stock options (Employee Ownership Program) that align your interests with the company's success.
* Yearly performance-based bonus, rewarding your hard work and dedication
* Leave Encashments
* Maternity/Paternity Leaves
* Employee Health covered under Medical, Group Term Life & Accident Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Employee development with LinkedIn Learning
* Employee recognition via Awardco
* Collaborative, multicultural work environment with a team of dedicated professionals, fostering innovation and teamwork.

*Life Is On*
for everyone, everywhere, and at every moment. As part of our growing digital ecosystem, we are strengthening our technical support capabilities for
**EcoStruxure Building Activate (EBA)**

We are seeking a highly skilled
**L4 Product Support Engineer**
to join our advanced support organization and ensure the reliability, stability, and continuous improvement of our building automation solutions in the field.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Level 4 Product Support Engineer provides expert-level technical support, advanced troubleshooting, and system-level diagnostics for complex issues that go beyond the scope of L3 support. This role serves as the technical escalation point for global support teams, partners, and country front-office engineers.
  
  
You will work closely with R&D, QA, product management, and field teams to analyze defects, replicate issues, propose corrective actions, and contribute to long-term product improvements. This role requires strong system thinking, analytical depth, and the ability to investigate issues spanning hardware, firmware, cloud, and mobile components.

**Advanced Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis**

* Investigate and resolve complex system-level issues across hardware, firmware, cloud, and mobile platforms.
* Analyze logs, traces, network captures, system metrics, and API interactions to identify root causes.
* Reproduce field issues in lab environments to validate hypotheses and support engineering teams.
* Own critical escalations from L3 teams, ensuring timely and high-quality resolution.
* Provide RCA documentation, corrective action proposals, and long-term recommendations.

**System-Level Analysis & Integration Support**

* Perform deep-dive analysis of EBA system architecture, including controllers, gateways, cloud components, and mobile workflows.
* Support integration efforts across different layers of the EBA platform and its external integrations.
* Validate end-to-end workflows to ensure subsystem interoperability and performance.
* Troubleshoot integration protocols such as BACnet, Modbus on the edge side and MQTT, REST APIs, HTTPS, and other IoT communication layers for the cloud communication
* Identify system bottlenecks, performance issues, and configuration defects.

**Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing**

* Serve as the bridge between field support teams and R&D engineering groups.
* Provide detailed field insights to influence product roadmaps and design decisions.
* Document troubleshooting guides, diagnostic procedures, and knowledge base articles.
* Deliver post-escalation briefings and contribute to continuous improvement loops.
* Mentor L3 engineers and help elevate the technical competence of the product support team.

* Contribute to product quality improvement initiatives, including failure mode analysis and test coverage enhancements.
* Participate in cross-functional reviews, defect triages, and technical deep-dive sessions.

* Recommend improvements in escalation workflows, documentation structure, and customer experience practices.

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, Instrumentation, or related field.
* 10+ years of experience in system-level troubleshooting, advanced technical support, or product integration roles.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills with experience diagnosing complex behaviours across distributed systems.
* Hands-on experience with building automation, HVAC systems, IoT devices, or industrial automation platforms.
* Proficiency in Python or similar scripting languages for automation, data extraction, and analysis.
* Strong knowledge of Windows/Linux fundamentals, networking (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, certificates), and API-level debugging.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to explain complex technical topics clearly.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience with HVAC systems and building controls.
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Grafana, and Jenkins.
* Hands-on experience with lab equipment (oscilloscopes, multimeters, analyzers).
* Knowledge of agile methodologies and collaborative workflows.
* Experience working in global, multiregional support environments.

* Deliver timely and effective resolution of escalated critical issues within defined SLAs.
* Improve product reliability by contributing RCAs, reproducible defect scenarios, and engineering-quality test cases.

title: Infrastructure Engineer II
description:
**Job Description**
The Infrastructure Patching & Security Engineering team ensures the security, stability, compliance, and operational resilience of enterprise infrastructure platforms through proactive patch management, vulnerability remediation, security hardening, automation, and continuous improvement.
  
  
The team is responsible for maintaining secure and compliant Red Hat Linux, Windows environments by implementing enterprise patching strategies, addressing security vulnerabilities, reducing infrastructure risk, and ensuring adherence to organizational security standards.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Windows Server, VMware, system administration, OS patching, vulnerability management, infrastructure security, automation, and scripting. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing enterprise-wide patching operations, remediating security vulnerabilities, troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, and driving automation to improve patch compliance and operational efficiency.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**OS Patching & Infrastructure Security Operations**

* Plan, coordinate, execute, and manage enterprise-wide operating system patching across Red Hat Linux and Windows infrastructure.
* Own end-to-end patch management activities, including patch assessment, planning, testing, deployment, validation, reporting, and remediation.
* Manage monthly, emergency, and out-of-band security patching cycles across production and non-production environments.
* Implement security patches, critical updates, kernel upgrades, and operating system fixes in accordance with enterprise security policies.
* Identify and remediate missing patches, outdated software packages, and infrastructure security vulnerabilities.
* Troubleshoot patch installation failures, dependency conflicts, repository issues, reboot failures, and post-patching system issues.
* Ensure patching activities are executed within approved maintenance windows with minimal business disruption.
* Develop patch rollback, recovery, and contingency procedures to minimize operational risks.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, cybersecurity, and change management teams to ensure timely patch deployment and compliance.

**Red Hat Linux, Windows & VMware Administration**

* Build, configure, administer, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Windows Server environments.
* Perform Linux patching using YUM, DNF, RPM, Red Hat Satellite, and related patch management tools.
* Manage Windows Server patching using Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), WSUS, or equivalent enterprise patching platforms.
* Support VMware ESXi and vCenter patching, upgrades, lifecycle management, and security remediation.
* Troubleshoot Linux kernel issues, package dependencies, system services, boot failures, filesystem issues, and OS performance degradation.
* Administer Windows Server infrastructure, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and Windows Update services.
* Perform server health checks, pre-patching readiness assessments, and post-patching validation.
* Support operating system upgrades, end-of-life remediation, server migrations, and infrastructure modernization.

**Vulnerability Management & Security Remediation**

* Partner with cybersecurity and vulnerability management teams to identify, assess, prioritize, and remediate infrastructure vulnerabilities.
* Analyze vulnerability scan results from tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or equivalent enterprise security platforms.
* Remediate critical and high-severity vulnerabilities within defined security SLAs.
* Investigate vulnerabilities associated with operating systems, software packages, system configurations, and infrastructure components.
* Implement security hardening recommendations based on CIS benchmarks, vendor guidance, and enterprise security standards.
* Address security findings related to outdated packages, insecure protocols, weak configurations, unsupported operating systems, and missing security patches.
* Support vulnerability exception management, risk acceptance processes, and remediation tracking.
* Coordinate with application owners and infrastructure teams to resolve vulnerabilities requiring application compatibility testing or planned downtime.
* Maintain accurate vulnerability remediation records, compliance evidence, and audit documentation.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce vulnerability exposure and infrastructure security risk.

**Patching Automation & Scripting**

* Design, develop, and maintain automation solutions for enterprise infrastructure patching and security remediation.
* Automate Linux and Windows patch deployment, patch validation, compliance checks, and operational reporting.
* Develop automation scripts using Python, Bash, PowerShell, and Ansible.
* Implement Ansible playbooks for Linux patching, server configuration, security hardening, and vulnerability remediation.
* Automate patch readiness checks, server reboot coordination, service validation, and post-patching health checks.
* Integrate patching workflows with enterprise automation, orchestration, and IT service management platforms.
* Develop reusable scripts and automation frameworks to reduce manual intervention and improve patching consistency.
* Troubleshoot automation failures and continuously optimize patch deployment workflows.
* Identify opportunities to improve patch success rates, reduce patching cycle times, and increase infrastructure compliance through automation.

**Patch Compliance, Governance & Reporting**

* Track and maintain infrastructure patch compliance across Linux, Windows, and VMware platforms.
* Monitor patch deployment status, remediation progress, patch failures, and outstanding security vulnerabilities.
* Generate patch compliance dashboards, vulnerability remediation reports, and operational metrics.
* Ensure infrastructure patching activities align with enterprise security policies, regulatory requirements, and internal audit standards.
* Support security audits by providing patching evidence, remediation documentation, and compliance reports.
* Identify systems that are non-compliant, unsupported, or approaching end of life and develop remediation plans.
* Manage patching exceptions, risk assessments, and remediation timelines in coordination with cybersecurity and risk teams.
* Drive improvements in patch coverage, patch success rates, vulnerability remediation SLAs, and overall security posture.

**Infrastructure Support & Incident Management**

* Provide advanced L2/L3 technical support for Linux, Windows, VMware, and infrastructure patching platforms.
* Troubleshoot complex operating system, patching, application compatibility, performance, and availability issues.
* Participate in major incident management, root cause analysis (RCA), and problem management activities.
* Investigate infrastructure incidents caused by failed patches, operating system updates, configuration changes, or security remediation.
* Coordinate with application, database, network, storage, security, and infrastructure engineering teams to resolve cross-platform issues.
* Perform proactive infrastructure health checks, monitoring, and performance optimization.
* Support production change implementation, maintenance activities, and emergency security patch deployments.
* Develop and maintain operational runbooks, patching procedures, troubleshooting guides, and technical documentation.
* Participate in on-call support and scheduled maintenance activities to ensure critical infrastructure availability.

**Qualifications**
**Required Experience & Technical Skills**

* 7 years of overall IT infrastructure, system administration, patch management, or infrastructure security engineering experience.
* Strong hands-on experience managing enterprise-wide operating system patching and vulnerability remediation across large-scale infrastructure environments.
* Extensive expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL 7/8/9 or later), including administration, patching, kernel upgrades, troubleshooting, and security hardening.
* Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server 2016/2019/2022 or later, including administration, security updates, patch deployment, and troubleshooting.
* Strong experience with VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, virtualization management, patching, and lifecycle operations.
* Hands-on experience with Linux patch management tools such as Red Hat Satellite, YUM, DNF, and RPM.
* Experience with Windows patch management platforms such as SCCM/MECM, WSUS, or equivalent enterprise tools.
* Strong understanding of vulnerability management processes and remediation using tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management using Ansible.
* Hands-on scripting experience using Python, Bash/Shell scripting, and PowerShell.
* Strong understanding of operating system security hardening, CIS benchmarks, vulnerability remediation, and patch compliance.
* Experience managing critical and high-severity security vulnerabilities and meeting defined remediation SLAs.
* Good understanding of enterprise networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewalls, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of enterprise storage technologies, filesystems, and infrastructure performance management.
* Experience with patching governance, change management, incident management, and ITIL processes.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across operating systems, infrastructure security, patching platforms, VMware, networking, and storage.
* Experience supporting large-scale production infrastructure in highly regulated environments.
* Strong communication, documentation, analytical, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE).
* Microsoft Windows Server or infrastructure certification.
* Red Hat Ansible Automation certification.
* Experience with Red Hat Satellite, Ansible Automation Platform, Microsoft Configuration Manager, and enterprise patch orchestration solutions.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow, CMDB, change management, and automated patch compliance reporting.
* Knowledge of CIS benchmarks, NIST security frameworks, and enterprise security compliance requirements.
* Experience implementing automated vulnerability remediation and infrastructure security controls.

title: Lead Infrastructure & Platform
description:
# Hiring Brief [Public]

## Infrastructure & Platform Lead

Location: On-site

Experience: 3–5 Years in one or more of:

- Infrastructure Engineering

- DevOps / Platform Engineering

- Systems Engineering

- Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)

CTC: 14 - 16 LPA

Team: Will lead 2–3 IT engineers

Reports to: CTO

## About SecNinjaz

SecNinjaz is building sovereignty-aligned cybersecurity and IT solutions designed to empower organizations with secure, resilient, and open technologies.

Our mission is to become a one-stop cyber solutions partner — architecting and delivering secure infrastructure, cybersecurity platforms, and advanced technology solutions while prioritizing open-source, sovereignty, and operational resilience.

Internally, we maintain a sophisticated infrastructure stack combining on-premise virtualization, secure networking, GPU compute, and developer platforms, enabling both product development and cybersecurity operations.

We are looking for a hands-on Infrastructure & Platform Lead who can take ownership of our internal IT and infrastructure, bring operational maturity, and build systems that scale with the company.

## Role Overview

The Infrastructure & Platform Lead will be responsible for designing, operating, and continuously improving SecNinjaz's internal infrastructure and IT environment.

This role requires a hands-on technical leader capable of managing virtualization, secure networking, identity systems, developer platforms, and security infrastructure while leading a small team of IT engineers. The candidate will also mentor junior infrastructure engineers and help establish professional operational standards.

You will ensure that our internal systems are secure, resilient, well-documented, professionally operated and compliant, forming the backbone of our cybersecurity and product engineering teams.

Candidates should demonstrate strong understanding of secure infrastructure design and operational security practices.

## Key Responsibilities

- Manage and maintain virtualization infrastructure

- Operate internal technology platforms and services

- Maintain secure networking and remote access infrastructure

- Implement monitoring, alerting, and backup systems

- Improve infrastructure documentation and operational processes

- Lead and mentor junior IT / infrastructure engineers

### Compliance & Governance

- Support and maintain organizational compliance requirements related to IT and cybersecurity

- Ensure infrastructure and systems align with defined security and compliance standards

- Assist in audits by providing required technical evidence and documentation

- Maintain proper access controls, logging, and system configurations as per compliance needs

- Continuously improve infrastructure practices to align with evolving compliance requirements

## Required Skills

Candidates should have experience with:

- Linux system administration

- virtualization platforms (Proxmox / VMware / KVM)

- networking fundamentals

- VPN technologies

- infrastructure monitoring

- backup systems

- infrastructure documentation

## Preferred Experience

Exposure to any of the following is beneficial:

- developer platforms (GitLab Premium/Ultimate)

- identity and access management systems

- containerization technologies

- infrastructure automation

- storage systems

## Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate:

- is hands-on with infrastructure technologies

- has experience managing production environments

- values documentation and structured operations

- is comfortable working in a fast-growing technical organization

Experience working with compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, ISO 9001, STQC, SOC2, etc.) is a plus.

## Important Note

* This role focuses on infrastructure engineering and platform operations, and is not a helpdesk or desktop support role.

Apply on LinkedIn or email your CV to jay@secninjaz.com with details of your CV, portfolio, your specific contributions, current CTC, expected CTC, and notice period or earliest date you can join SecNinjaz.

**Designation: L2 Operations Engineer – Network Security**

**Support level: L2 Operations**

**Domain: Network Security**

**Scope: Palo Alto Firewalls, Zscaler, SSE, ZTNA, Enterprise Browser, Internet Security (SWG and FWaaS), and Private Access**

**Job Location / Reporting Location: NCR - Gurugram**

**Process:**

• End-to-end incident management, from L1/L1.5 escalation to closure.

• Run firewall health checks (CPU and memory) and act on breaches.

• Collect logs and evidence for firewall alert events.

• Troubleshoot reported issues and check network connectivity.

• Enable new access per application needs, through the client's change process.

• Handle port and rule requests from other teams, including server teams.

• Apply firewall patches and OS upgrades under change control.

• Handle outage calls to restore connectivity.

• Support Zscaler and Palo Alto firewalls.

• Protect data in transit and at rest from unauthorised access.

• Report security issues promptly with recommended actions.

• Follow client security standards and guidelines.

• Keep ServiceNow tickets current, with clear resolution and closure notes.

• Join RCA reviews. Update SOPs and knowledge-base articles.

• Work with Connectivity, Hosting, IDAM, DLP and Malware Tools on cross-tower issues.

• Trace policy evaluation in SSE (Zscaler Internet Access, Prisma Access and similar) – URL filtering, Cloud Firewall, SSL inspection, DLP, CASB – and in Prisma Access (security, decryption, URL filtering rules) to find unexpected allows or blocks.

• Diagnose Private Access failures across application segments, segment groups, server groups, access policies and Private Service Edge.

• Troubleshoot forwarding profiles, PAC files, trusted network detection and bypass configuration.

• Diagnose GRE and IPsec tunnel failures to Zscaler, and Remote Network and Service Connection tunnels in Prisma Access, including IKE/IPsec phase issues.

• Resolve DNS issues for private apps, including split DNS, conditional forwarding and DNS search domains.

• Troubleshoot SAML assertion and attribute problems, SCIM provisioning failures and group sync issues with Entra ID, Okta or Ping.

• Resolve device posture and trusted network check failures.

• Take and analyse packet captures (Wireshark, tcpdump, connector-side captures).

• Correlate logs across the SSE platform, SIEM, IdP and endpoint tools.

• Use ZDX and ADEM data to diagnose latency, edge selection and path problems.

**Tools:**

• Palo Alto firewalls (Cloud Firewalls)

• Zscaler

• Palo Alto NGFW, Panorama, Strata Cloud Manager, Strata Logging Service, Prisma Access

• Splunk SIEM

• Datadog

• Enterprise monitoring tools

• ServiceNow

• Okta (secondary skill)

**Technologies:**

• Subject-matter expertise (8+ years) in NGFWs, WAFs, multi-cloud networking and security controls, core networking protocols, and security architecture – primarily Palo Alto, AWS and Azure, with GCP and Alibaba Cloud as a plus.

• Deploying security policies with IPS, URL filtering, DNS security and SSL inspection.

• Firewall security policy tuning with tools such as AlgoSec.

• Quickly identifying and remediating root cause.

• ITaaS, ITIL, monitoring and metrics.

• Multi-cloud networking.

• Firewall administration.

• Secure web gateway.

• Access and rule management.

• Network segmentation.

• Firewall log analysis.

• TCP/IP and routing basics.

• Python or Ansible scripting.

• IaC tooling: GitHub, Octopus, Terraform.

• DNS expertise.

**Experience:**

• 12 years of experience in L2 network security operations

• 24x7 support environment

• Palo Alto firewall administration

• Zscaler administration (scope to be confirmed)

• Enterprise networking expertise

• Firewall rule and port request handling

• Log and evidence collection

• ITSM incident, problem and change processes

• Clear written and spoken English

**Certifications:**

• Palo Alto PCNSA / PCNSE

• Zscaler administrator certification

• CCNA

* Manage identity lifecycle processes, access reviews, and Privileged Access Management (PAM).
* Implement modern authentication solutions, including MFA, passwordless authentication, SSO, FIDO2, Conditional Access, and certificate-based authentication.
* Manage authentication protocols such as Kerberos, LDAP/LDAPS, SAML, OAuth 2.0, and OIDC.
* Maintain Active Directory forests, domain controllers, replication, trusts, password policies, and gMSA accounts.
* Manage certificate lifecycles and troubleshoot PKI, CRL, OCSP, and certificate-validation issues.
* Secure Kubernetes environments using RBAC, workload identities, service accounts, and secrets management.
* Develop PowerShell automation for identity operations, compliance reporting, monitoring, and security auditing.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across Active Directory, DNS, PKI, authentication, Kubernetes, and Windows Server.
* Support incident response, root-cause analysis, security assessments, system hardening, audits, and compliance activities.

**Your profile**
You have
**8–15 years of experience**
and strong hands-on expertise in:
  
  

* Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and PKI
* MFA, SSO, passwordless and certificate-based authentication
* PAM, identity governance, and hybrid identity
* Kubernetes identity security and access controls
* PowerShell scripting and automation
* Security hardening, troubleshooting, incident response, and compliance

You are analytical, proactive, and committed to delivering secure, stable, and automated identity solutions.
  
  
**We get curious people invested in the world**

We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

title: HPC Engineer
description:
**About Us**

PlusWealth Capital Management LLP is a proprietary high-frequency trading firm, active in multiple markets including equities, options, and futures. We thrive on building cutting edge, data-driven, and tech-based trading algorithms. As a dynamic, machine-learning oriented trading platform, we embody the ethos of THINK. TECH. TRADE. If you share our vision, we’d love to have you onboard.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a skilled HPC Engineer in designing, deploying, and managing High Performance Computing (HPC) environments. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on expertise in Slurm Workload Manager, Parallel File Systems (PFS), Linux administration, and HPC infrastructure operations. The role requires someone who can independently build and support HPC clusters.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Design, deploy, and administer HPC clusters from scratch.

- Install, configure, and manage Slurm (Controller, Compute Nodes, Munge, Accounting, Partitions, QOS, Scheduling, etc.).

- Deploy and administer Parallel File Systems such as BeeGFS, Lustre

- Monitor cluster health, performance, and resource utilization using enterprise monitoring tools.

- Troubleshoot issues across compute, storage, networking, and job scheduling.

- Perform capacity planning, patching, upgrades, and operational maintenance.

- Automate routine administration tasks using Bash, Python, or Ansible.

- Work closely with infrastructure, networking, and application teams to optimize HPC performance.

**Required Skills**

- 5–8 years of hands-on experience in HPC administration.

- Strong expertise in Slurm Workload Manager with end-to-end deployment and administration.

- Experience with at least one Parallel File System (BeeGFS or Weka).

- Strong Linux administration skills (RHEL/Ubuntu).

- Good understanding of HPC networking concepts, including Ethernet, InfiniBand/RDMA, VLANs, and storage networking.

- Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, or similar.

- Good scripting skills in Bash and/or Python.

- Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Skills**

- Experience with GPU clusters, or cloud-based HPC environments.

- Knowledge of automation and configuration management tools such as Ansible.

**Benefits & Perks:**

* Competitive compensation and performance-based bonuses.
* Flat organizational structure with high ownership and visibility.
* Medical insurance – we've got you and your dependents covered.
* Catered meals/snacks for 5 working days in the office.
* Generous paid time off policies.

**Pluswealth Capital Management is an equal opportunity employer**

description:

The team plays a critical role in solution design, technical consulting, bid management, and customer engagement across enterprise security opportunities.

The Security Presales Consultant will be responsible for understanding customer requirements, architecting cybersecurity solutions, supporting technical sales engagements, and driving successful solution adoption. The role requires strong expertise in Cisco Security technologies and multi-vendor security platforms, along with the ability to translate business needs into scalable and secure architectures.

+ Cisco ASA
+ IPS / IDS Solutions

* Ensure seamless handover to delivery teams with complete solution documentation, assumptions, implementation approach, and scope definition.

**Who We're Looking For**

* 5-10 years of experience in Security Presales, Network Security, Security Consulting, or Solution Architecture.
* Strong expertise in Cisco Security technologies, including FTD, FMC, ASA, IPS, and IDS.
* Hands-on experience with Check Point and/or Fortinet security solutions.
* Strong understanding of enterprise network and security architecture.
* Experience in preparing HLDs, LLDs, BOM/BOQ, RFP responses, and technical proposals.
* Exposure to firewall migration, security transformation, and security modernization projects.
* Excellent customer-facing, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work with sales, OEMs, partners, and delivery teams in a fast-paced environment.

**Core Competencies**

* Security Presales & Solution Consulting
* Cisco Security (FTD, FMC, ASA)
* Check Point Security Solutions
* Fortinet FortiGate
* Network & Cybersecurity Architecture
* HLD / LLD Design
* BOM / BOQ Preparation
* RFP & Tender Management
* Security Assessments & Migration Planning
* Customer Presentations & POCs
* Technical Proposal Development
* Stakeholder Management & Business Communication

**Preferred Certifications**

* Cisco CCNP Security / CCIE Security
* Cisco Firepower Certifications
* Check Point CCSA / CCSE
* Fortinet NSE Certifications
* CISSP, CISM, or equivalent security certifications (preferred)

title: IT & Systems Executive
description:
**About Athena**

Athena Education is India’s leading college admissions consultancy, guiding around 1,000 students each year toward the world’s most selective universities. With offices in Gurgaon, Bengaluru, and Mumbai, a rapidly growing international client base, and a team of approximately 180 people across counselling, academics, product, and operations, Athena is continuing to scale its footprint and capabilities.

**About the Role**

This will be Athena’s
**first dedicated IT hire**
, with end-to-end ownership of the organization’s technology environment.

Our students and families trust us with highly sensitive information, including academic transcripts, financial information, personal essays, and university portal access. Your role will be to ensure that Athena’s technology ecosystem is
**secure, reliable, well-managed, and cost-efficient**
as the organization grows.

This is a high-ownership role with a clear mandate, significant autonomy, and direct access to leadership. You will have the opportunity to build and strengthen Athena’s IT infrastructure, systems, security practices, and processes from the ground up.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Device & Endpoint Security:**
  Own the complete laptop fleet across Athena’s three offices, including asset management, mobile device management (MDM), disk encryption, patching, antivirus, and the secure issuance and recovery of devices.
* **Identity & Access Management:**
  Implement and manage single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor authentication (MFA), role-based access controls, and same-day access provisioning and revocation as team members join, transition roles, or exit the organization.
* **Data Protection & Compliance:**
  Ensure Athena remains aligned with India’s DPDP Act and relevant client-side data requirements. Establish and maintain data classification and retention policies, vendor agreements, and a tested incident-response framework.
* **Credential & Records Security:**
  Move shared credentials and sensitive student records into secure, centralized, and auditable systems while establishing strong access and records-management practices.
* **Network & Workplace Infrastructure:**
  Manage internet connectivity and redundancy, Wi-Fi, VPNs, meeting-room AV, printing, and other workplace technology across the Gurgaon, Bengaluru, and Mumbai offices.
* **Software & Cost Optimization:**
  Build and maintain a centralized register of all software and technology tools used across Athena, including ownership, renewal dates, license counts, and costs. Identify opportunities to renegotiate contracts, consolidate tools, optimize licenses, and eliminate unnecessary expenditure.
* **IT Support & Enablement:**
  Build and manage an efficient internal helpdesk with clear service levels, ensure every new joiner is fully set up from Day 1, and create straightforward documentation that enables teams to resolve common issues independently.

**Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience managing IT environments for organizations with
  **100+ users**
* Hands-on experience with
  **Google Workspace administration**
  and device management platforms such as Intune, Jamf, Scalefusion, or similar tools
* Practical experience implementing and managing
  **SSO, MFA, identity management, and access controls**
* Strong experience managing technology vendors, contracts, licenses, and renewals
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical risks and solutions clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Exposure to compliance and information-security frameworks such as
  **DPDP, GDPR, SOC 2, or ISO 27001**
* Experience supporting technology infrastructure across
  **multiple office locations**
* Experience using
  **scripting or automation**
  to streamline routine IT and administrative tasks
* Previous experience in an organization handling
  **sensitive personal or client data**
* Relevant certifications in
  **IT, information security, cloud, or cybersecurity**

title: Technical Account Manager, ES - INDIA
description:
**Description**
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”
  
  
As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises.
  
  
As a Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:
  
  

* Learn and use Cloud technologies.
* Interact with leading technologists around the world.
* Work on critical, highly complex customer problems that may span multiple AWS Cloud services.
* Apply advanced troubleshooting techniques to provide unique solutions to our customers' individual needs.
* Work directly with AWS Cloud subject matter experts to help reproduce and resolve customer issues.
* Write tutorials, how-to videos, and other technical articles for the customer community.
* Leverage your extensive customer support experience and provide feedback to internal AISPL teams on how to improve our services.
* Drive projects that improve support-related processes and our customers’ technical support experience.
* Assist in Design/Architecture of AWS and Hybrid cloud solutions.
* Help Enterprises define IT and business processes that work well with cloud deployments.
* Be available outside of business hours to help coordinate the handling of urgent issues as needed.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 7+ years of hands-on infrastructure, troubleshooting, systems administration, networking, DevOps or applications development experience
* Experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Be mobile and travel to client locations as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

- AWS India - Haryana

 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Your Career As a Professional Services Consultant, you will be a pivotal technical expert, spearheading the successful deployment and initial configuration of our Prisma Access Browser (PAB) solution for customers. This is a highly impactful, hands\-on role where you will directly translate customer security requirements into a fully operational and optimized cloud\-delivered browser security solution. Working closely with customers, solution consultants, and project managers, you will implement PAB according to best practices and customer\-specific needs. Beyond deployment, you will be a proactive driver, navigating complex environments, anticipating roadblocks, and accelerating our customers' journey to a Zero Trust architecture. You will solidify customer partnerships with Palo Alto Networks by ensuring they successfully adopt and maximize the value of PAB. If you thrive on technical challenges, leading complex deployments, and being the face of strategic, results\-driven implementation, this is your next career move. Your Impact Proactively Drive Technical Deployment: Execute the complete technical lifecycle of PAB implementation, including secure tenant setup and complex Identity Provider (IdP) integrations. Take ownership of the deployment timeline, proactively managing and overcoming any customer hesitations or delays to ensure rapid time\-to\-value Translate Strategy to Security Policy: Convert customer business and security designs into practical, effective PAB configurations, focusing on access controls, data loss prevention (DLP) rules, and web security policies Drive Adoption: Guide customers through the secure and large\-scale deployment of the PAB extension/client to end\-user devices using various enterprise deployment methods (e.g., GPO, MDM) Be a Proactive Technical Advisor: Serve as the go\-to expert for PAB best practices, advanced feature utilization, and performance tuning, actively monitoring environments to pre\-emptively identify, recommend, and resolve potential issues or areas for security posture improvement Resolve Complex Escalations: Act as the primary technical escalation point, performing deep\-dive root cause analysis and coordinating across Support, Engineering, and Product teams for timely resolution Document and Transfer Knowledge: Create high\-quality, customer\-specific "as\-built" documentation and deliver comprehensive operational training and knowledge transfer to customer administrators Advocate for the Customer: Capture and translate valuable field feedback into actionable feature requests, serving as a critical internal voice for product improvement and development Maintain expert\-level understanding of Prisma Access Browser: Stay updated on latest product releases, security trends, and industry best practices.  **apply AI/ML and AI agents to Cloud Infrastructure operations**

 You will collaborate closely with Cloud Infrastructure peers, SREs, Security Engineering, and product teams across geographies.

* Design, implement, and operate highly available, secure, and scalable AWS infrastructure (e.g., VPC, Transit Gateway, EC2, Load Balancing, S3, EBS/EFS/FSx, Route 53, IAM, KMS, Backup).

* Measure and communicate impact of AI automation (MTTR reduction, hours saved, error reduction, cost optimization, improved engineer experience).


**Reliability, Operations \& On‑Call**
* Own the reliability and performance of services you build – from design through deployment and production operations.
* Implement and tune monitoring, logging, alerting, and SLO/SLA dashboards for Cloud Infra services (Datadog/Splunk/CloudWatch or similar).
* Participate in the on‑call rotation, lead troubleshooting for complex AWS infrastructure incidents, and drive post‑incident reviews and preventative improvements.
* Proactively identify technical debt and reliability risks in infrastructure and drive remediation plans.


**Collaboration, Mentoring \& Best Practices**
* Act as a technical mentor to Engineer I/II teammates on AWS fundamentals, automation patterns, and AI‑driven operations.

**Required Qualifications**
**Here's What You Need:**
* 3–6 years of hands\-on‑ experience in Cloud / Infrastructure Engineering, or similar roles, with strong focus on AWS.
* Deep understanding of core AWS services: VPC \& networking (subnets, routing, TGW, VPN/Direct Connect, security groups, NACLs), EC2, Auto Scaling, Load Balancing, S3, EBS/EFS/FSx, Route 53, IAM, KMS, CloudWatch/CloudTrail, and Backup.
* Strong experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code (AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform) and Git\-based workflows (branching, PR reviews, CI/CD).
* Solid programming skills in at least one language commonly used for infra\-automation, such as Python or TypeScript/Node.js.
* Proven track record designing and operating production\-grade, multi‑account/multi‑region AWS environments with a focus on security, reliability, and cost.
* Experience implementing observability for infrastructure services (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, dashboards).
* Demonstrated ability to own complex projects end\-to\-end: requirements, design, implementation, rollout, and post‑launch improvements.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills; comfortable working with distributed teams and multiple stakeholders (SRE, Security, product engineering, leadership).


**AI / Agentic Skills – Required**
* Practical experience building or integrating LLM\-based solutions (e.g., using OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure/OpenAI\-compatible, or similar APIs).
* Hands\-on experience with at least one of:
+ AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph\-style, CrewAI\-like, or custom agent patterns), or
+ Orchestrating multi\-step AI workflows using tools, function calling, or custom planners.

* Ability to translate infra problems into agentic workflows (e.g., “given alerts \+ context, generate and execute an actionable runbook; escalate with a summarized context if confidence is low”).
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), and techniques to constrain and evaluate AI outputs in production.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience in a large\-scale SaaS or multi‑tenant environment.
* Exposure to cost optimization / FinOps in AWS (right‑sizing, storage optimization, data transfer analysis, automated cleanup).
* Experience with security engineering concepts such as least‑privilege IAM design, KMS usage patterns, and network security controls.
* Experience integrating AI agents with ticketing and workflow platforms (Jira/ServiceNow, Slack/MS Teams bots, internal tools).
* AWS certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional, Security – Specialty, or Advanced Networking) or equivalent experience.


**Success in This Role**
**In Your First 12–18 Months, Success Looks Like**
* You are a go‑to engineer for complex AWS infrastructure questions in your domain.
* You have delivered at least one or two production AI‑agent workflows that measurably improve Cloud Infra operations (e.g., reduced MTTR, reduced manual toil, or better cost visibility).
* Your infrastructure services are well‑documented, observable, and resilient, with clear runbooks and strong hand‑offs to on‑call engineers.

* Role Summary


 We are looking for an IT Lead — someone who will be the single point of ownership for everything IT at iDream Education. This is not a narrow infrastructure or helpdesk role; it is a domain\-ownership role spanning internal systems, network and cloud infrastructure, our field\-deployed device fleet (iPrep Tablets and other hardware), data security, and compliance.
   

  

 You will be the person who ensures our internal teams never lose a working day to IT friction, and who ensures thousands of devices deployed across schools and NGOs in rural India stay secure, tracked, and functional. You will also be the one building the IT function itself — starting hands\-on, and growing it into a proper team as iDream scales.
   

  

* Key Responsibilities \& Deliverables


**IT Infrastructure, Systems \& Support**
* Own and manage all internal IT infrastructure — networks, servers, cloud services, and systems administration — ensuring uptime, reliability, and security across office operations.
* Run IT helpdesk and support for all employees, ensuring fast turnaround on hardware, software, and access\-related issues.
* Own vendor relationships for hardware, software licenses, ISPs, cloud providers, and AMC contracts — negotiating terms, managing renewals, and controlling IT spend.


**Device \& Field Hardware Fleet Management**

* Build and maintain systems for remote monitoring, troubleshooting, and updates of devices deployed at scale in low\-connectivity environments.

**Data Security \& Compliance**

* Ensure the organisation's data handling practices align with DPDPA 2023 and other applicable data protection requirements.
* Conduct periodic security audits and risk assessments, and build/maintain IT policies, SOPs, and documentation.


**AI\-First IT Operations:** 
 Bring AI\-augmented workflows into IT operations — from automated monitoring and alerting to AI\-assisted troubleshooting, documentation, and reporting — keeping iDream's IT stack modern and lean.

**Experience:** 
 5–7 years in IT infrastructure, systems administration, or IT operations, with demonstrable ownership across networks, hardware/device management, and security — ideally including experience managing hardware deployed outside a single office (field, retail, or distributed environments).
   

  

**Sector Context:** 
 Experience in EdTech, the Development sector, or mission\-driven B2B/B2G environments is a strong advantage. Experience managing device fleets in low\-bandwidth or rural contexts is a plus.
   

  

**Technical Proficiency:** 
 Strong grounding in networking, systems administration (Windows/Linux), cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), and device/MDM (mobile device management) tools.
   

  

**Security \& Compliance:** 
 Working knowledge of IT security fundamentals and data protection principles, including familiarity with DPDPA 2023\.
   

  

**Vendor \& Budget Management:** 
 Proven experience managing vendor contracts, AMC negotiations, and IT budgets.
   

  

**AI Fluency:** 
 You use AI tools as a daily productivity layer for monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, and reporting — not as a novelty.
   

  

* Key Skills \& Competencies


**What Makes You a Great Fit?**
 You think in systems, not tickets. You've owned IT for an organisation before — not just responded to issues as they came in — and you know how to build infrastructure and processes that scale without breaking. You're equally comfortable troubleshooting a server issue and thinking through how thousands of tablets in rural India stay secure and functional. You're excited about using AI to make IT operations faster and leaner, and you've already started building that into how you work.

* Excellence: Builds reliable, secure, scalable, and AI\-enabled IT systems while continuously improving infrastructure, processes, and support.
* Collaboration: Works effectively with internal teams, vendors, and technology partners to ensure seamless IT operations and successful hardware and system deployments.
* Impact: Enables uninterrupted business operations and ensures secure, reliable technology reaches teams, schools, and last\-mile learners at scale.

 We are on a mission to take the best of digital learning to every corner of rural Bharat. At iDream, you will have the opportunity to build and own the IT function from the ground up — one that keeps our teams productive and our technology reaching the last\-mile learner securely and reliably.
